findings.title: useEffect dependency array omits userId and onLoaded
findings.description: The effect fetches `userId` and calls `onLoaded` but its dependency array is empty, so it runs once and never refetches when userId changes — the card shows a stale user. Add [userId, onLoaded] (and stabilise onLoaded with useCallback in the parent).
findings.suggestion: Use `}, [userId, onLoaded]);` and memoise onLoaded in the parent.
